qualifications: Core depth locates the reported current-speed maximum in a sampled profile; it is not a lower flow boundary, connected penetration, layer thickness or water depth.
The observed surface gap prevents a claim that the sampled maximum is the unsampled full-water-column maximum.
Deployment-mean profile maxima are distinct from maxima of instantaneous profiles or mean instantaneous core depths. Station deployment dates are not resolved to a common exact interval.
The two dates and two mean profiles are correlated campaign evidence; not five independent campaigns, monthly climatologies, annual extrema or a seasonal range.

The weak June17 C3 interbranch flow at37m is not admitted as a current core. The paper's separate41m comparison level, thermocline, water depths and current-speed error index are not depth boundaries or depth uncertainty.
No exact station coordinates, new named branches, mapped route interpolation, figures, raw profiles, physical thickness or volume are reconstructed.
